title: Morning Brief — Saturday, 24 October 2026
description: A severe multi-state storm system builds across eastern Australia, Queensland opens a new critical minerals processing facility in Townsville, and Gold Coast maritime crews respond to three boat incidents on the Broadwater in a single day. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
